note: Premier Energies Ltd. Eight calls Q2 FY25 (first post-IPO call) to Q1 FY27; all held and opened. Q1 FY26 rests on the AlphaStreet verbatim reproduction (filed copy not located); Q3 FY26 and Q4 FY25 on the BSE filing via the Business Standard mirror. Fetch tool caps quotes at ~125 characters, so some quotes are verbatim fragments joined with '...'. Timeline or capacity items with a 'by' deadline that was already met are graded although the period has not closed (the outcome cannot change). Same-call duplicates merged and noted. No numeric revenue/EPS guidance was ever given (management cites board policy); no prior numeric guide existed, so no class 9 items. No class-10 override applied: no contradicted assurance met the SEVERE test. Recurring misses: transformer capacity (16.75 GVA by Apr then Jul 2026, now 16.25 GVA by FY28), wafer/ingot (2 GW by FY26 to 10 GW from Dec 2027), BESS/inverter (Q1 FY27 to paced; KSolare abandoned), 'no new debt'. Recurring delivery: module capacity early, margins above every anchor. Rule 6: no class-10 item is a Reg. 30 statutory impact line; nothing removed. v1.2 rule-7 re-grade: restatements merged into originating items (Naidupeta/Seetharampur 4+4 GW chain -> Q2 FY25; 1.2 GW TOPCon line -> Q2 FY25, regraded 1->0 as an unreasoned cut; 1.2 GW ramp -> Q3 FY25; 16.75 GVA -> Q2 FY26; BESS -> Q4 FY25; ingot-wafer -> Q4 FY25; aluminium, wafer -> Q2 FY25; KSolare -> Q2 FY26; US plant -> Q2 FY25, graded 1 as reasoned cut); RHP (Aug 2024) added outside_window for the 4+4 GW project cost; recency weights now 9..1; score 6.9 -> 7.8 (rises because repeated misses now count once).
